item.title: Hillside Residence by Prentiss + Balance + Wickline Architects
item.description: The 2400 sf Hillside House sits comfortably on a forested slope strewn with enormous boulders. The owners entrusted us with their dream of a comfortable home for an active family of five. At our first meeting, one of the owners shared a sketch of a u-shaped floor plan that literally hugged the largest, most prominent boulder. item.title: Foster + Partners designs Manhattan skyscraper for American Express
item.description: American Express has announced plans to construct a new global headquarters at 2 World Trade Center in Lower Manhattan. Located at 200 Greenwich Street, the headquarters has been designed by Foster + Partners, with American Express being the sole owner and occupant of the tower. The firm also recently completed a new headquarters for JPMorganChase in the city. item.title: Woodgreen by Martinko Studios
item.description: The Woodgreen House is sited with careful consideration of landscape and solar orientation, preserving six mature fruit trees that anchor the property while maximizing access to natural light. Designed in close collaboration with a family that frequently entertains, the home reflects a client-centered approach that prioritizes openness, fluid circulation, and spatial generosity.
